dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: Provides many concrete thresholds (e.g., 3 families × 3 AZs for 99.9% availability, lambda timeout ≥ 60 s, deregistration delay 30‑60 s) and decision‑tree ordering that a generic model would not know, but a portion of the content merely restates well‑known AWS best‑practice guidance, so full marks are not earned.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Encodes AWS‑specific procedures: exact pre‑flight checklist order, precise CLI commands for pipeline setup, replacement‑strategy tuning, and lifecycle‑hook configuration. Missing a tiny bit of detail on the ordering of capacity‑rebalance vs interruption handling, hence a small deduction.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: Contains a thorough NEVER list with concrete reasons (e.g., never set ELB deregistration > 2 min, never use lowest‑price with a single pool). Could be stronger on IAM least‑privilege pitfalls, so one point is deducted.

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Front‑matter is complete, description, when‑to‑use, activation triggers and invocation schema are present. Activation trigger list is verbose and could cause over‑matching, preventing a perfect score.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: Information is layered (quick reference → mindset → pre‑flight → process → anti‑patterns). Some sections (e.g., full reference tables) are dense, causing slight cognitive overload, so not full marks.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Destructive actions are tightly gated by a mandatory CONFIRM step and extensive pre‑checks; creative planning steps are left flexible. Calibration matches task fragility perfectly.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: Follows a clear, repeatable pattern (quick reference, mindset, pre‑flight, process, output format, anti‑patterns). Minor deviation in ordering of some sections prevents a perfect score.

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Model outputs demonstrate correct planning, step generation, and verification for most operations. However, audit‑pipeline‑health example lacks concrete post‑verification actions after remediation, and error‑handling for failed Lambda invocation is not fully fleshed out, leading to a modest deduction.
